goal: Identify minimum sufficient finite lag for deterministic scalar affine autoregressions over rational numbers using exact linear algebra, not assume past depth.
methods: For each lag d=0..4, fit an affine autoregression y_t=c+sum_{i=1}^d a_i*y_(t-i) with full-column rank and exact residual zero on training prefix; select smallest d that passes, then test held-out continuation. Handle constant sequences as d=0. Reject fits without unique coefficients.
negative_controls: Too-short sequence lacks independent equations, must report unidentifiable
Periodic pattern can be exactly predicted using an order-2 recurrence, even if given an order-4 generative description; distinguish minimal observable order from authored description
Noise or changes to recurrence make exact time-invariant model invalid; reject rather than invent fit
limits: All systems assistant designed; synthetic arithmetic not external blind benchmark
Minimum only within constant-coefficient affine autoregressive family up to order 4
